    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Build project
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          echo "Build output" > dist/output.txt
          echo "Build complete"

      - name: Upload build artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 5
